description: Get current weather conditions and 7-day forecast. Uses Open-Meteo API (free, no API key required). Accepts city name or coordinates. Returns temperature, humidity, wind, precipitation, and daily forecasts.

latitude.description: Latitude (-90 to 90). Use with longitude as alternative to city name.

longitude.description: Longitude (-180 to 180). Use with latitude as alternative to city name.

name: query_weather
